name: Nasu to Sanma no Oishii Sekai
original_name: 茄子と秋刀魚の美味しい世界
source:
"When something fun happens, don't you inexplicably not want to die?"
The unstable and broken daily life of me and "her" who says such things with a laugh.
--Come on, let's withdraw. To the world.
Because eggplants and pacific saury are delicious.

It is a game about a protagonist who wants to withdraw from society, tries hard to do so, but cannot.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090211005003/http://novel.misw.jp/tonoshii/]official website[/url]]
